sources: MAME src/mame/sega/naomi.cpp @59e7c0b line 10501 (cart-PCB comment above the mj1a-mj1/mj1 ROM_STARTs): 'uses CRP-1231 card RW connected via 838-13661 RS422/RS232C converter BD, and 2x JVS I/O boards (or one special I/O ?)'

https://github.com/GXTX/YACardEmu — Sanwa CRP-1231BR-10/LR-10NAB is a magnetic-stripe card reader/dispenser (3 data tracks, 69 B each), the same reader family used across Sega Naomi/Chihiro/Triforce network cabinets (Initial D3, WMMT, Mario Kart Arcade GP)

https://www.sega.jp/history/arcade/product/17883/ (official Sega arcade history page; via search snippet, direct fetch blocked HTTP 403 per kb §4.o) — cabinet control panel is touchscreen for tile selection plus dedicated hard buttons (agari/win button called out specifically), consistent with the MJ1-era panel style

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sega_Network_Taisen_Mahjong_MJ — confirms the MJ series' satellite-terminal/national-network-ranking architecture (MJ5 later added multi-touch, implying the MJ1-era cabinet in this dump used the touchscreen+hard-button combo above)
